# Claim–source matrix

| Manuscript claim | Source or internal theorem | Support type |
|---|---|---|
| The heat kernel is a lattice plaquette action with useful weak-coupling structure. | Menotti–Onofri 1981, DOI 10.1016/0550-3213(81)90560-5 | Primary historical and model source |
| For generator `1/2 Delta`, `2t log p_t(x,y)` tends to minus squared distance. | Varadhan 1967, DOIs 10.1002/cpa.3160200210 and 10.1002/cpa.3160200404 | Primary analytic theorem; normalization checked |
| Conditional sensitivity can be encoded by a Dobrushin interdependence matrix. | Dobrushin 1968, DOI 10.1137/1113026 | Primary criterion source |
| Strong uniform conditional probabilities can imply product domination for dependent indicators. | Liggett–Schonmann–Stacey 1997, DOI 10.1214/aop/1024404279 | Primary domination theorem |
| Central twists/flux sectors and their free energies are established gauge-theory objects. | 't Hooft 1979; Mack–Petkova 1980; de Forcrand–von Smekal 2002 | Primary center-flux literature |
| Constructive gauge RG separates and controls small/large field contributions rather than assuming every boundary is free. | Balaban 1987, 1988, 1989 | Primary constructive-RG sources |
| A private opposite link exists for every incident plaquette. | Lemma 3.1 | New internal proof |
| Arbitrary central incident staples are realizable. | Proposition 3.2 | New internal proof |
| The conditional kernel has the product form. | Proposition 3.3 and Appendix A | New internal proof |
| The full minimizing set has fixed distance pair `(L/m,(m-1)L/m)`. | Lemma 3.5 | New internal proof from metric identity |
| The target-good exponent is exactly `-m(b_*-rho)^2`. | Theorem 3.6 and Appendix B | New internal theorem |
| The conclusion has open positive-measure stability. | Theorem 4.1 | New internal theorem |
| The microscopic Dobrushin row criterion fails for small heat time. | Theorem 4.3 | New internal theorem |
